# Spawning reference

The mob spawner, its weighted prefab pool, and the hooks that decide how gameplay creates and removes objects. For how to use it, see [Spawning](../modules/spawning.md).

## VtMobSpawner

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Spawning → VtMobSpawner**.

Scene-placed spawn point. Keeps `Count` units alive around its position, respawns each one `VtUnitDefinition.respawnTime` seconds after it dies, and can pick from a weighted pool of prefabs, scatter a pack inside a radius, hand spawned units a patrol route, reuse dead instances instead of instantiating, and spawn only in some day phases of the scene's `VtWorldClock`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prefab (`prefab`) | `GameObject` | None |  | Prefab to spawn. Must contain a VtUnit. Its definition's Respawn Time schedules respawns. |
| Variants (`variants`) | [VtSpawnVariant](#vtspawnvariant)[] | Empty |  | Optional weighted pool. When it has entries, every spawn picks one of them instead of Prefab. |
| Count (`count`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | How many units this point keeps alive at once. 1 = one monster, 3 = a pack. |
| Spawn Radius (`spawnRadius`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Units appear at a random point within this radius of the spawner. 0 = exactly here. |
| Spawn On Awake (`spawnOnAwake`) | `bool` | On |  | Fill the spawn point on Awake. Off lets you call TrySpawn or SpawnAll yourself. |
| Respawns After Death (`respawnsAfterDeath`) | `bool` | On |  | Respawn a unit after it dies, after its definition's Respawn Time. Respawn Time 0 disables it per unit. |
| Reuse Instances (`reuseInstances`) | `bool` | Off |  | Revive the dead instance in place on respawn instead of instantiating a new one. The corpse stays where it fell until its respawn timer fires. |
| Corpse Linger Seconds (`corpseLingerSeconds`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Seconds a corpse stays before it is removed. 0 = leave it. Ignored when Reuse Instances is on. |
| Patrol Route (`patrolRoute`) | [VtPatrolRoute](ai-roaming.md#vtpatrolroute) | None |  | Optional patrol route the spawned units walk. Adds a VtRoaming to units whose definition has none. |
| Active Phases (`activePhases`) | [VtDayPhaseDefinition](world-time.md#vtdayphasedefinition)[] | Empty |  | Day phases this point spawns in, read from the scene's VtWorldClock. Empty = always. With Spawn On Awake the point fills when one of these phases begins. |
| Despawn Outside Phases (`despawnOutsidePhases`) | `bool` | On |  | Remove the live units and corpses when the clock leaves the Active Phases. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `VtUnit CurrentUnit { get; }` | The first live unit, or null. Packs expose every unit through `LiveUnits`. |
| `bool HasLiveUnit { get; }` | True while at least one spawned unit is alive. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtUnit> LiveUnits { get; }` | Every spawned unit that is currently alive. |
| `int LiveCount { get; }` | Number of live units. |
| `int PendingRespawns { get; }` | Number of respawn timers currently running. |
| `float RespawnSecondsRemaining { get; }` | Seconds until the next respawn, 0 when none is pending. |
| `GameObject Prefab { get; }` | The default prefab. |
| `int Count { get; set; }` | How many units the point keeps alive. |
| `VtPatrolRoute PatrolRoute { get; set; }` | Patrol route handed to every spawned unit's `VtRoaming`. |
| `VtDayPhaseDefinition[] ActivePhases { get; set; }` | Day phases this point spawns in. Empty = always. |
| `bool DespawnOutsidePhases { get; set; }` | Remove live units and corpses when the clock leaves `ActivePhases`. |
| `bool IsInActivePhase { get; }` | True when the scene clock is in one of `ActivePhases`, when the list is empty, or when the scene has no `VtWorldClock`. |
| `event Action<VtUnit> OnUnitSpawned` | Fires after every spawn and every revive. |
| `event Action<VtUnit> OnUnitDied` | Fires when a spawned unit dies. |
| `event Action<float> OnRespawnTimerStarted` | Fires when a respawn timer starts, with its length in seconds. |
| `void Initialize()` | Follow the scene clock's phases and fill the point when `Spawn On Awake` is set. Idempotent. |
| `void SetRandom(IVtRandom random)` | Replace the random source, for deterministic variant picks and scatter such as in replays. Null restores Unity's random. |
| `int SpawnAll()` | Spawn until `Count` units are alive. Returns how many were spawned. |
| `virtual bool TrySpawn(out VtUnit spawned)` | Spawn one unit. Returns false on a missing prefab, a prefab without a `VtUnit`, a full point, outside the `ActivePhases`, or a replica-side call. |
| `void Despawn()` | Remove every live unit, corpse and timer. Does not start respawns. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance respawn and corpse timers by `deltaTime` seconds. Authority-only. |
| `protected virtual GameObject InstantiatePrefab(GameObject source, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)` | Create the instance. Override to register it with your networking layer. |

## VtSpawnVariant

Serializable struct.

One entry of a `VtMobSpawner` weighted prefab pool.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prefab (`prefab`) | `GameObject` | None |  | Prefab with a VtUnit at its root. |
| Weight (`weight`) | `float` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Relative chance. 3 next to 1 spawns this prefab three times out of four. 0 never spawns. |

## VtSpawning

Static class.

Creates and removes the objects gameplay spawns while the game runs: loot on the ground, placed buildings, projectiles, summons, spawner mobs and buildings restored from a save. The default instantiates and destroys locally. A networked game points `InstantiateFn` and `DespawnFn` at its framework's spawn calls once at bootstrap, as the co-op sample's spawn hooks do. A game with object pools points them at its pools.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static Func<GameObject, Vector3, Quaternion, GameObject> InstantiateFn` | Creates an instance of a prefab at a pose. Null uses `UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate`. |
| `static Action<GameObject> DespawnFn` | Removes an instance. Null destroys it. |
| `static GameObject Instantiate(GameObject prefab, Vector3 position, Quaternion rotation)` | Create an instance of `prefab` through `InstantiateFn`. Null for a null prefab. |
| `static void Despawn(GameObject instance)` | Remove `instance` through `DespawnFn`. |
| `static void ResetHooks()` | Restore the local defaults. |
